name: Magical Athlete
variant: base (4 races: Pepere, Galere, Pepere, Galere)

rounds.endCondition: Game ends when the 4th race is finished

categories.label: Gold trophies (1st place)
categories.hint: One entry per gold trophy won: the points printed on the chip (value rises with later races).

categories.label: Silver medals (2nd place)
categories.hint: One entry per silver medal won: the points printed on the chip.

categories.label: Bronze 1-point stars
categories.hint: Earned through athlete abilities / Star spaces.

categories.label: Bronze 3-point stars
categories.hint: A 3-point star can stand in for three 1-point stars.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players celebrate a shared victory.

notes: family: race-to-goal. Verified against the official IELLO rulebook: 4 races; the race ends the moment the 2nd athlete crosses the line (1st takes the top gold trophy of the stack, 2nd the top silver medal); bronze 1-point and 3-point star chips come from athlete powers and Star spaces (a 3-point chip substitutes for three 1-point chips); after race 4 the player with most points wins, ties are a shared win. Gold/silver chip values are printed on the chips and rise with each race, so the scorer enters each chip value. If athlete eliminations leave no 2nd place the silver medal is discarded. 2-player and 3-player variants (each player fields 2 athletes per race, 8-athlete teams) use the same scoring. A different track programme may be agreed before play. Not the 2002 Magical Athlete.
